import os
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-5e7186de.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
with open(p,'w') as f: f.write('''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    for r, c in points:
        for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
            if 0 <= c + dc < w:
                out[r][c + dc] = 8
    return out
''')
print(open(p).read())
